panels.title: Workout route

panels.description: Heart rate plotted against elapsed workout minutes. This chart is independent of Grafana's global dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (s.time-w.start_time))/60)::numeric,2)::double precision AS "Elapsed minutes",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_average') AS "Average HR",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_minimum') AS "Minimum HR",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_maximum') AS "Maximum HR" FROM workout_samples s JOIN workouts w ON w.id=s.workout_id WHERE s.workout_id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND s.phase='workout' AND s.metric LIKE 'heart_rate_%' AND s.time>=w.start_time-interval '1 minute' AND s.time<=w.end_time+interval '1 minute' GROUP BY s.time,w.start_time ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Heart rate during workout

panels.description: Recovery heart rate plotted against minutes after the workout ended, independent of the global dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (s.time-w.end_time))/60)::numeric,2)::double precision AS "Recovery minutes",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_average') AS "Recovery average",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_minimum') AS "Recovery minimum",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='heart_rate_maximum') AS "Recovery maximum" FROM workout_samples s JOIN workouts w ON w.id=s.workout_id WHERE s.workout_id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND s.phase='recovery' AND s.metric LIKE 'heart_rate_%' GROUP BY s.time,w.end_time ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Heart-rate recovery

panels.description: Elevation and speed plotted against elapsed workout minutes, independent of the global dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (r.recorded_at-w.start_time))/60)::numeric,2)::double precision AS "Elapsed minutes",r.altitude_meters AS "Altitude",r.speed AS "Speed" FROM workout_routes r JOIN workouts w ON w.id=r.workout_id WHERE r.workout_id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND r.recorded_at>=w.start_time-interval '1 minute' AND r.recorded_at<=w.end_time+interval '1 minute' ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Route elevation and speed

panels.description: Workout samples plotted against elapsed minutes. Units differ, so use the tooltip and legend to compare timing and shape.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (s.time-w.start_time))/60)::numeric,2)::double precision AS "Elapsed minutes",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='active_energy') AS "Active energy",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='basal_energy') AS "Basal energy",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='step_count') AS "Step count",max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric='walking_running_distance') AS "Distance" FROM workout_samples s JOIN workouts w ON w.id=s.workout_id WHERE s.workout_id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND s.phase='workout' AND s.metric NOT LIKE 'heart_rate_%' AND s.time>=w.start_time-interval '1 minute' AND s.time<=w.end_time+interval '1 minute' GROUP BY s.time,w.start_time ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Workout metric overlay

targets.rawSql: SELECT interval_type AS "Type",sequence+1 AS "#",start_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone' AS "Start",round(coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time))::numeric,1) AS "Seconds",coalesce(target_distance::text||' '||target_distance_unit,metrics_json#>>'{distance,qty}') AS "Distance",round(NULLIF(metrics_json#>>'{heartRateAverage,qty}','')::numeric,0) AS "Avg HR",round(NULLIF(metrics_json#>>'{heartRateMaximum,qty}','')::numeric,0) AS "Max HR",round(NULLIF(metrics_json#>>'{speed,qty}','')::numeric,2) AS "Speed m/s",round(NULLIF(metrics_json#>>'{paceMile,qty}','')::numeric,1) AS "Pace sec/mi",round(NULLIF(metrics_json#>>'{activeEnergy,qty}','')::numeric,1) AS "Active kcal" FROM workout_intervals WHERE workout_id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid ORDER BY interval_type,sequence;

SELECT replace(h.metric,'_',' ') AS "Metric",h.unit AS "Unit",count(*) AS "Samples",round(avg(h.value)::numeric,2) AS "Average",round(min(h.value)::numeric,2) AS "Minimum",round(max(h.value)::numeric,2) AS "Maximum" FROM health_metrics h JOIN workouts w ON w.id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND h.user_id=w.user_id AND h.time BETWEEN w.start_time AND w.end_time WHERE h.metric IN ('physical_effort','blood_oxygen_saturation','respiratory_rate','headphone_audio_exposure','walking_speed','walking_step_length') GROUP BY h.metric,h.unit ORDER BY h.metric;

SELECT start_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone' AS "Started",end_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone' AS "Ended",source AS "Source",source_name AS "Device/source name",round(min_heart_rate_bpm::numeric) AS "Min HR",round(average_heart_rate_bpm::numeric) AS "Avg HR",round(max_heart_rate_bpm::numeric) AS "Max HR",(SELECT count(*) FROM workout_routes r WHERE r.workout_id=w.id) AS "Route points",(SELECT count(*) FROM workout_samples s WHERE s.workout_id=w.id) AS "Metric samples",(SELECT count(*) FROM workout_intervals i WHERE i.workout_id=w.id) AS "Intervals" FROM workouts w WHERE id=NULLIF('$workout_id','')::uuid AND user_id='$user_id'::uuid;
